movie.title: Rage of Stars
movie.overview: A story about a woman from the International Special Forces Unit, who has a premonition about the impending end of humanity.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An International Special Forces agent races against time to prevent a cataclysmic extinction after receiving vivid premonitions of humanity's impending doom.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: When an elite operative from the International Special Forces Unit is struck by harrowing visions of total global destruction, she must convince a skeptical military command of the threat's reality. As her premonitions begin coming true with terrifying precision, she uncovers a hidden global crisis threatening to wipe out mankind. Teaming up with a select group of allies, she embarks on a high-stakes race to stop the end of humanity before time runs out. The narrative blends explosive action with atmospheric science-fiction and intense emotional drama.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Agent Elena Vance is a top operative within the International Special Forces Unit, renowned for her tactical brilliance and unshakeable composure under pressure. Her life changes drastically during a covert operation when she experiences a sudden, violent premonition depicting the horrific destruction of Earth. Initially dismissed by her superiors as battle fatigue or psychological trauma, Elena is forced to investigate the visions on her own. She quickly discovers subtle, unsettling anomalies occurring across the globe that mirror her exact visions. Realizing that an ancient or otherworldly catastrophe is unfolding behind the scenes, she forms a rogue task force of trusted mercenaries and scientists. Together, they decipher cryptic clues tied to her premonitions while dodging international law enforcement and hostile factions intent on keeping the truth buried. As the terrifying timeline predicted by her mind ticks closer to zero, Elena must face both physical adversaries and the grueling psychological toll of her gift. In a frantic final battle against catastrophic forces, she risks everything to avert the apocalypse and secure a future for mankind.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Rage of Stars follows an elite member of the International Special Forces Unit who experiences powerful, mysterious premonitions forecasting the apocalyptic end of human civilization. Driven by these terrifying visions, the protagonist must navigate high-stakes military warfare, global conspiracy, and supernatural mystery to uncover the truth behind her visions. Fusing fast-paced action, futuristic intrigue, and character-driven drama, the story explores themes of destiny, survival, and the burden of foresight in the face of absolute annihilation.

story_structure.climax: The impending threat reaches its peak, forcing her into a desperate final confrontation where the survival of humanity hinges on a single, perilous choice.
story_structure.conflict: Struggling to convince skeptical authorities while deciphering the nature of the apocalyptic threat, she must act independently to stop an impending global catastrophe.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the crisis, the immediate danger subsides, laying bare the cost of survival and reshaping the heroine's path forward in a transformed world.
story_structure.introduction: An elite operative from the International Special Forces Unit discovers a horrifying premonition that humanity faces imminent extinction, establishing the high-stakes reality of her mission.
story_structure.risingAction: As cosmic and geopolitical tensions escalate, she uncovers deeper secrets, gathering allies and racing against time through increasingly dangerous high-stakes missions.
